items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Jones, Arthur Briggs, Bobby Jones -- ... Bobby Jones, second trumpet. ... his Harlemites. And the band includes Arthur Briggs, and Bobby Jones on trumpets

ctx.x: And I used to take, at first two lessons a week, until he said, no, one is enough. Bobby Jones and I, -- the boy I showed you on the picture.
